name: agentguard-js
description: AgentGuard TypeScript SDK for Web2 Resource Providers: Signature Verification & Soroban Contract RBAC

scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}));"
scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.test: node --test --experimental-strip-types --experimental-test-coverage tests/errors.test.ts tests/verifier.test.ts tests/contract.test.ts tests/middleware.test.ts tests/interop.test.ts
